note: Which Higgsfield offering does each job best (Brew picks; a brand never chooses a model). Prices come from /estimate at run time; formulas are Higgsfield's published rates for the workflows whose /estimate only describes them. Tested 23 Oct 2026: Marketing Studio Flare kept a 3-item kit exact where Gemini 3 Pro Image didn't.

product-shot.label: A photograph of the real product in a real moment

default.why: GPT Image 2.5 Flare keeps the product from up to 16 reference photos; 2K out

preview.why: a cheap look at the idea before the full shot

ad-concepts.label: Several finished ad concepts from a brief

default.why: Ads Studio writes and renders whole ad concepts from a brief and product photos

type-poster.label: A graphic where the type is the picture (poster, offer card)

brand-graphic.label: Illustration, icon set, pattern or vector

default.why: Recraft draws clean brand graphics in set colours

people-moment.label: A lifestyle or portrait photo with no product

default.why: Soul makes natural, editorial people photos
edits a supplied picture by instruction

product-motion.label: Bring a product shot to life (one shot)

default.why: Kling 3.0 Pro keeps the first frame's product, native 1080p; ~$0.08/s after discount (23 Oct: $0.39 for 5 s)

shot-from-refs.label: A video shot built from product photos (no start frame)

default.why: Kling O3 holds identity from reference photos; ~$0.07/s
first and last frame set exactly

ugc-video.label: A person talking about or using the product, with sound

default.why: Seedance holds the product and a person across a talking clip; ~$0.30/s at 720p

premium.why: Seedance 2.5, best people and sound; ~$0.46/s at 720p

default.why: edits a clip by instruction, keeps its motion

video-restyle.label: Restyle or swap an object in a clip

default.why: Genjutsu swaps an object and keeps the motion

motion-copy.label: Copy a viral clip's motion onto our picture

default.why: applies a reference clip's motion to our image
